subject: System Design
title: The AWS US-East-1 Outage
description: A 60-second lesson on The AWS US-East-1 Outage.

hook.text: In December 2021, half the internet broke. Netflix, Disney+, Slack, and Ring doorbells all went down.

buildup.text: AWS US-East-1, the oldest and most popular region, experienced a network disruption.

discovery.text: An automated scaling activity overwhelmed internal network devices, cascading into widespread failures.

twist.text: The AWS console itself was affected, so engineers couldn't monitor or fix the problem through normal tools.

climax.text: Thousands of companies learned a painful lesson: depending on a single cloud region is a single point of failure.

punchline.text: When one region fails, the world notices.

quiz.question: What caused the AWS US-East-1 outage in 2021?
options: Automated scaling overwhelmed internal network devices
